newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-WILKINSON HITS FREE STATE OUT OF TROUBLE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WILKINSON HITS FREE STATE OUT OF TROUBLE.

text.p: A swashbuckling 87 from captain Louis Wilkinson hit Free State out of early innings trouble on the opening day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Northern Transvaal at Centurion Park on Friday.

Asked to bat first on a difficult surface in overcast conditions, Wilkinson rescued his side from a precarious one for two in the sixth over. When bad light ended play with 2.4 overs still to be bowled, Free State had reached an impressive 349 for eight.

Wilkinson dominated a third-wicket stand of 141 in only 34 overs with opener Gerhardus Liebenberg (49) and struck 11 fours and two sixes before he was removed by debutant seamer Pierre Joubert shortly after lunch.
At the crease for a little over two hours, Wilkinson was particularly severe off the back foot and faced only 98 balls during his destructive innings.

Positive middle order batting from Kosie Venter (76) and Franklyn Stephenson (36) during a fifth-wicket partnership of 99 - and useful tail-end resistance from Bradley Player (48) and Philip Radley (24 not out) - then ensured that Free State had the better of the first day's play.
Fast bowler Rudi Bryson did the early damage for a disappointing Northern Transvaal attack before lunch as he exploited bounce and movement off the seam to take 2-20.
But the 18-year-old Joubert, recovering from a loose first spell, found good rhythm during the afternoon to finish with deserved figures of 3-52.
Bowling: Elworthy 20.2-3-88-1, Bryson 23-5-84-3, Kruis 12-2-60-0, Joubert 22-7-52-3, Davis 18-6-23-0, Rindel 2-0-13-0, van Zyl 4-1-15-0.
Northern Transvaal: A.Seymore, M.Davis, R.Pienaar, R.Richardson, M.Rindel, D.van Zyl, S.Elworthy, I.Pistorius, P.Joubert, R.Bryson, D.Kruis.
Bonus points: Northern Transvaal - three; Free State - four.
